WP-03 (release status) is vc's, in lib/release plus the status branch of lib/cmd/release, built against dc's CORRECTED notes contract in lib/release.notes: `notes_select <kind> <run> <project>` takes the project name once; `notes_state <root> <v>` prints absent | open | dated YYYY-MM-DD and refuses a malformed note with exit 1; `notes_check <root> <v> <today>`; `notes_date <root> <v> <date>`; `notes_body <root> <v>`; `notes_views <root>` and `notes_views_check <root>` take only the root; `notes_paths <root> <v>`; and `notes_where <v>` is new. Open for WP-03 before building: what status prints for steps with no postcondition, which tree step 4's "clean" means, how a push is read without fetching, and whether status runs ci.query.
